description: This Dart file defines the OceanTheme class, providing a comprehensive theme configuration for a Flutter application. It includes color constants, theme data setup with color schemes, text styles, component styles, and helper methods for gradient backgrounds and shadows, all tailored to implement a consistent Ocean Professional look and feel.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: Provides a set of static methods and constants for customizing the Flutter app's theme, including color palettes, theme data, gradient backgrounds, and shadows, all themed around an Ocean Professional aesthetic.

methods.name: themeData
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with the Ocean color scheme, typography, and component styles for consistent theming across the app.

methods.name: gradientBackground
methods.description: Creates a BoxDecoration with a subtle linear gradient matching the Ocean theme, suitable for background decoration.

methods.name: softShadows
methods.description: Provides a list of BoxShadow objects that create soft drop shadows for UI elements consistent with the Ocean theme.
